# sidecar-servers (generated — do not edit)

This directory holds the PyInstaller-frozen helper servers and the bundled
whisper model that the **self-contained** installer ships and
`src-tauri/src/sidecars.rs` spawns at runtime:

```
proxy/proxy.exe              Claude-CLI proxy        (port 8765, claude mode only)
stt/stt.exe                  local faster-whisper    (port 8766, always)
models/whisper-base/...      bundled CT2 STT model
```

Everything except this README is git-ignored and regenerated by:

```
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File proxy\freeze-sidecars.ps1
```

`tauri build` bundles whatever is present here. In CI (only this README is
present) the normal lightweight app is produced; after running the freeze
script locally the full self-contained installer (~204 MB) is produced.
This README is the placeholder that keeps the `sidecar-servers/**/*` bundle
glob in `tauri.conf.json` valid even when the binaries are absent.
